author: Skingley86
quote:
Beautiful setting and an engaging story. 

I don't love the way the story finished personally, and some of the gameplay sections leave a little to be desired but for a small scope game available for under £30 now, you absolutely cannot go wrong if you are looking for a story driven experience.

author: Skingley86
quote:
Best game of all time, somehow made better by two of the best expansions gaming has ever seen. 

Incredible story, engaging character progression and your gameplay decisions actually matter.

author: Skingley86
quote: Incredible heartful story journey within an interactive, beautiful and lived in world. Gameplay is on the more relaxed slower side.

author: Skingley86
quote:
Beautiful world and at times fun gameplay and character progression.

Story extremely lacking and large difficulty spikes can leave you banging your head against the wall. Personally don't enjoy spending my evening farming runes to try and get powerful enough to progress.

author: Skingley86
quote:
The premise of the game is a good one and fun can be had with it, I certainly enjoyed large parts of my playthrough.

But the story was incoherent and hard to follow, the optimization is very poor with huge frame drops in built up areas and the gameplay loops and pawn dialogue can both be extremely repetitive.

Shame really, was excited and enjoying the first 10-15 hours, but by the culmination of the story I was glad it was over and will not be interesting in touching future DLC.
